title: Permit synthetic environment templates in the task pipeline
requirements: Preserve rejection of real environment files and secret-like paths, while allowing the exact synthetic template name .env.example when it is explicitly inside the task allowed_paths.
Add regression coverage for the allowed .env.example case and for rejection of .env, .env.local, nested environment files, and a template outside allowed_paths.
Document the narrow exception so a template is never treated as a credential source or context file.
acceptance: A task explicitly allowing .env.example can pass scope validation for that synthetic template.
Real .env files and secret-like files remain rejected by the policy tests.
The full pipeline test suite passes.

shared_paths_approval.reason: The pipeline policy currently contradicts the accepted ENV-001 contract; this narrowly restores support for a synthetic template without permitting local credentials.
